'''Rei Reeven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Rei needs help NOW! I need you to rush these medical supplies to him.|Ralia Reeven, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SM" />}}
Rei Reeven was a member of the [[Reeven Clan]],<ref name="SWG:SM" /> a Rodian clan allied with [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] since before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SC">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones]]''</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was also a member of the Lok Revenants, working as a field [[Agent/Legends|agent]].<ref name="SWG:SM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Reeven got injured and ended up stranded in the middle of the [[Great Maze of Lok]]. However, he was rescued by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by one of his clanmates, Nym's [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] [[Ralia Reeven]]. The spacer found his way in the maze successfully and carried medical supplies to Rei Reeven before it was too late.<ref name="SWG:SM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rei Reeven was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rei Reeven was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:SM" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
